statusNote: The figures and dates below are from the OSPP 2025 student guide and timeline; OSPP 2026 communities are being approved.
summary: The Open Source Promotion Plan (OSPP, 开源之夏) is a summer program organized by the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences. It encourages university students worldwide to develop and maintain open source software with mentors from participating communities.
runBy: Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences

stipend.detail: Completion bonus per project, before tax: 8,000 RMB for a basic project and 12,000 RMB for an advanced project. International students are paid by SWIFT bank transfer, converted to USD at the exchange rate on the transfer date.

payments.label: After the final evaluation
payments.when: Once the organizing committee's final review is passed

facts.label: Projects
facts.value: One application per student; one student per project

facts.label: Certificate
facts.value: For students who pass the final evaluation

eligibility: A currently enrolled university student (enrolled through September 30), from anywhere in the world.
Chinese students verify with ID and enrollment documents; international students with a passport and proof of admission.
howToApply: Register on the OSPP website as a student.
Choose one project, talk to its mentor and submit your application materials.
If selected, sign the agreement and develop the project from July to September.
Pass the mentor and organizing committee final reviews to receive the bonus and certificate.
